faq.q: What PHP and Laravel versions are supported?
faq.a: PHP 8.2+ and Laravel 10.x through 13.x. It auto-registers via Laravel's package discovery — no manual provider setup needed.
MySQL 5.7+, PostgreSQL 9.6+, and SQLite 3.24+. The CSV strategy is fastest on MySQL and PostgreSQL; SQLite generally does better with the default bulk-insert strategy.

faq.q: Should I use fromFactory() or generate()?
faq.a: Use `fromFactory()` to reuse your existing factory as-is — best for up to ~500k rows. Use `generate()` with the Faker-free TurboData helpers for 500k+ rows, where it's the fastest and most memory-predictable path.

faq.q: Does the CSV strategy need extra setup?
faq.a: PostgreSQL needs nothing extra. MySQL just requires `local_infile` enabled both client- and server-side. Run `php artisan turbo-seeder:test-connection` to check. If it's unavailable, TurboSeeder falls back to the default strategy automatically.

faq.q: Is it safe to run against a production database?
faq.a: By default, every run is guared - refused outside `local/testing` environments. The CLI command prompts for confirmation (use `--force` to skip).
